name: 23117 · Mineral, VA
findings: ZIP 23117 (Mineral) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23117 (Mineral) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
